caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a slightly overhanging lid, sitting on four small round feet. The wood is rendered in rich brown tones, with visible grain patterns and shaded areas to indicate depth and dimension. The front panel of the chest has decorative inlay or painted design featuring a central basket motif from which stylized vines or stems extend outward, ending in floral shapes, with the letters “S” and “R” incorporated into the design. There is a keyhole in the upper center of the front panel. The edges of the chest show dovetail joinery. In the upper left corner of the main sheet, there is a small inset drawing of the same chest showing dimensions (7 1/2 inches width, 4 1/4 inches height) in a similar perspective. The whole drawing is surrounded by a double-lined rectangular border, and the artist’s name, Samuel Freeman, along with the date 1861, is inscribed in cursive in the lower right corner. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Bible Box
